desc: positive: Test HTB with FQ_CODEL - basic functionality
pre: ip link add v0p1 type veth peer name v0p0 && ip link set v0p1 up && ip link set v0p0 up
tc qdisc add dev v0p1 root handle 1: htb default 11
tc class add dev v0p1 parent 1: classid 1:1 htb rate 10kbit
tc class add dev v0p1 parent 1:1 classid 1:11 htb rate 10kbit prio 0 quantum 1486
tc qdisc add dev v0p1 parent 1:11 fq_codel quantum 300 noecn

readback.cmd: tc -s qdisc show dev v0p1 | grep -A 5 'qdisc fq_codel'
readback.name: verify
